# An invoice posting to `Income:Sales USD`, applying the cash sale's split on
# that same account.
#
# The account match a bill relies on, on the invoice side. Here it must not
# be enough: moving the split takes the sale off the profit and loss, and a
# sale leaving is the failure Q-039 was reported for. Bills are allowed it
# because the cost is a cost either way; revenue is not.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal, with the revenue still on the income
# account.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-SAME-INCOME"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-03-16
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-16
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-16
    due: 2026-04-16
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-SAME-INCOME"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-16
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "1122aabb3344ccdd5566eeff77880099"
    txn_split_guid: "aabb3344ccdd5566eeff77880099aabb"
